sources.title: Neural basis of a perceptual decision in the parietal cortex (area LIP) of the rhesus monkey
sources.key_contribution: Foundational: LIP neurons show ramping activity correlated with choice and reaction time during motion discrimination

sources.title: Response of neurons in the lateral intraparietal area during a combined visual discrimination reaction time task
sources.key_contribution: RT version of RDM: LIP reaches fixed threshold before saccade, threshold firing rate consistent across coherence levels

sources.title: The neural basis of decision making
sources.key_contribution: Comprehensive review mapping DDM parameters to LIP neural signals; bridges behavior and neural physiology

sources.authors: Rorie AE, Gao J, McClelland JL, Newsome WT
sources.title: Integration of Sensory and Reward Information during Perceptual Decision-Making in Lateral Intraparietal Cortex (LIP) of the Macaque Monkey
sources.key_contribution: Reward mainly shifts starting point (not drift rate) of LIP accumulation; dissociates two-channel mechanism for value vs sensory integration

sources.authors: Latimer KW, Yates JL, Meister ML, Huk AC, Pillow JW
sources.title: Single-trial spike trains in parietal cortex reveal discrete steps during decision-making
sources.key_contribution: Statistical comparison showing ~75% of LIP neurons better described by discrete stepping than continuous ramping; challenge to DDM accumulator interpretation

sources.authors: Seideman JA, Stanford TR, Salinas E
sources.title: A conflict between spatial selection and evidence accumulation in area LIP
sources.key_contribution: Compelled RDM task reveals inverse relationship: stronger evidence yields weaker LIP differentiation under time pressure; suggests LIP may primarily reflect spatial attention not accumulation

sources.authors: Stine GM, Trautmann EM, Jeurissen D, Shadlen MN
sources.title: A neural mechanism for terminating decisions
sources.key_contribution: Superior colliculus acts as threshold sensor: detects when LIP crosses bound and triggers saccade; SC inactivation prolongs LIP accumulation

sources.authors: Steinemann N, Stine GM, Trautmann E, Zylberberg A, Wolpert DM, Shadlen MN
sources.title: Direct observation of the neural computations underlying a single decision
sources.key_contribution: Neuropixels population recording (54-203 neurons) shows single-trial LIP dynamics match DDM: 1D manifold (PC1=44% variance), autocorrelation structure consistent with diffusion, temporal mediation p<10^-317

sources.authors: Wongtrakun J, Zhou SH, O'Connell RG, Chong TTJ, Bellgrove MA, Coxon JP
sources.title: The role of human intraparietal sulcus in evidence accumulation revealed by EEG and model-informed fMRI
sources.key_contribution: EEG+fMRI: left hIP3 (IPS) BOLD correlates with CPP slope (accumulation speed); human homolog of monkey LIP performs analogous evidence integration

sources.title: A population representation of the confidence in a decision in the parietal cortex
sources.key_contribution: LIP population encodes decision confidence: covariance structure before response carries information about choice accuracy, distinct from mean decision variable

sources.authors: Newsome WT, Britten KH, Movshon JA
sources.title: Neuronal correlates of a perceptual decision
sources.key_contribution: MT microstimulation biases motion discrimination decisions: earliest causal evidence for MT-to-decision pathway
